title: Murder in the Phoenix park, before you were born, I suppose. I’ll show you.
html_source: “Murder in the Phoenix park” refers to the assassination, May 6th 1882, of Lord Frederick Cavendish, British secretary for Ireland and Thomas Henry Burke, his undersecretary. They were stabbed to death in Phoenix Park by members of the Irish National Invincibles.
